# hrobot_vswitch (Data Source)

Fetches vswitch information.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) vSwitch ID.

### Read-Only

- `cancelled` (Boolean) vSwitch cancellation status.
- `cloud_network` (Attributes List) List of cloud networks attached to vSwitch (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_network))
- `name` (String) vSwitch name.
- `server` (Attributes List) List of servers connected to vSwitch. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server))
- `subnet` (Attributes List) List of additional subnets on vSwitch. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnet))
- `vlan` (Number) VLAN assigned to vSwitch.

<a id="nestedatt--cloud_network"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_network`

Read-Only:

- `gateway` (String) Gateway IP on vSwitch subnet.
- `id` (Number) Cloud network ID
- `ip` (String) vSwitch subnet address on cloud network.
- `mask` (Number) vSwitch subnet mask on cloud network.


<a id="nestedatt--server"></a>
### Nested Schema for `server`

Read-Only:

- `server_ip` (String) IPv4 of server.
- `server_ipv6_net` (String) IPv6 of server.
- `server_number` (Number) Server ID
- `status` (String) Server status


<a id="nestedatt--subnet"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnet`

Read-Only:

- `gateway` (String) Subnet gateway
- `ip` (String) IP on subnet
- `mask` (String) Subnet mask
